title: Stripesmod
description: a cool mod that adds stuff
body:
Brand new adventures await in this Minecraft mod.Venture into new worlds, and enter the chain dimensions, Otherside dimensions, and more.Gain new pets, including Stripes the cat.Become the greatest chef Minecraft has ever seen with all the new foods and eat things that probably should never have entered your mouth in the first place! Craft new ridiculous weapons and armor, including Stripesmetal, an alloy of extreme durability.Defeat new bosses, and fight new mobs, as you reach the end, and craft the Block of Remembrance. You might even choose to go farther... who knows what you can find?
[NOTE: OTHERSIDE NOT FINISHED]
